title: Hexspeak
interviewTips: State the brute-force approach first before presenting the optimal Binary Search technique.
Discuss Time and Space complexities upfront before writing code.
Test on empty inputs and single-element edge cases.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Linear Scan (Brute Force)
approaches.intuition: Examine every candidate answer sequentially from the start to the end until a valid match is found.
approaches.theory: Linear scan tests all N candidates one by one without exploiting monotonicity.
edgeCases: Target smaller than minimum or larger than maximum.

approaches.name: Approach 2: Binary Search (Optimal)
approaches.intuition: Because the search space is monotonic (sorted or monotonic predicate), calculate the midpoint `mid = left + (right - left) / 2` and discard half the search space in each step.
approaches.theory: Halving the search range in each iteration guarantees logarithmic steps: log2(N). Using `left + (right - left) / 2` prevents integer overflow.

timeComplexity.explanation: Search interval is halved in every iteration.

edgeCases: Array with 1 element, target not present in array.
